test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which eminent violinist from Karnataka was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2025 for his outstanding contributions to Indian classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lakshminarayana Subramaniam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lakshminarayana Subramaniam**, an eminent violinist from Karnataka, has been internationally recognized for his contributions to **Indian classical music**.
 
• He is regarded as a **virtuoso violinist**, blending the traditions of **Carnatic music** with elements of Western classical music.
 
• Lakshminarayana Subramaniam has performed across the globe, gaining acclaim for his **unique style** and his ability to seamlessly fuse different genres of music.
 
• His contributions to music include **composing, performing, and teaching**, which have significantly enriched the realm of **Indian classical music**.
 
• In **2025**, he was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, for his **outstanding contributions** to Indian classical music.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is awarded for ** across various fields, such as arts, science, public service, and sports.
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is Lakshminarayana Subramaniam.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Padma Awards:**

 
 
• Instituted in **1954**, the Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• The awards are categorized into **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• **Example:** Other recipients of the Padma Vibhushan include **MS Subbulakshmi** for Carnatic music and **Ravi Shankar** for Hindustani classical music.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• **Carnatic music** is one of the two major traditions of Indian classical music, originating in South India.
 
• Characterized by its **complex rhythms** and **melodic structures**, it often involves the use of vocal and instrumental renditions.
 
• **Violin:** The violin has become an integral part of Carnatic music performances, with virtuosos like Lakshminarayana Subramaniam bringing global recognition to this art form.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options:**

 
 
• **Anant Nag:** A renowned Kannada actor, not related to Indian classical music.
 
• **Gangubai Hangal:** A Hindustani classical vocalist from Karnataka, but she passed away in **2009** and was awarded Padma Bhushan in **1971**.
 
• **Ricky Kej:** A music composer from Karnataka, known for his contributions to global music and environmental awareness, but not awarded the Padma Vibhushan in **2025**.
